messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: noticed ~10% of accounts missing external_customer_id after orchestration -> CRM handoff; playbooks skipped. Anyone seen similar?

dan_engineering: saw spikes in logs overnight. Appears enrichment sometimes runs after crm.upsert (race). FK errors and null external_id observed.

alex_ops: affected env? prod only?

maria_cs: prod only, mostly trial-enterprise. Staging fine.

leah_cs: manual fixes are slow. Suggest: 1) id enrichment backfill, 2) propagate onboard_ready, 3) trigger playbook in shadow. Canary first.

dan_engineering: agree. I'll prepare an idempotent backfill with checkpointing. Canary = 1k accounts. Schedule 02:00-05:00 PT, expected 2-3h.

playbook-bot: playbook `welcome_sequence` paused for 1,012 records due to missing external_customer_id.

maria_cs: safety: only set onboard_ready when playbook_state != 'started' and last_touch < 60d and manual_remediation != true.

dan_engineering: will add filters. Sample SQL (batched):
``
UPDATE crm_customers c
SET external_customer_id = e.external_id
FROM identity_enrichment e
WHERE c.id = e.customer_id
  AND c.external_customer_id IS NULL
LIMIT 5000;
```

alex_ops: ops constraints: throttle to crm bulk endpoint (~1500/hr). I'll own the window and monitor rate limits. Abort if 5xx > 1.5% for 5m.

sudhir_se: add metrics to Console: `onboard_flag_mismatch_count`, `external_id_backfill_rate`, `playbook_shadow_triggers` with 1h/7d windows.

leah_cs: dry-run results on canary: 76% auto-match, 24% flagged for manual review (missing billing contact or ambiguous corporate id). No duplicate triggers in shadow.

maria_cs: owners: dan -> backfill + PR, alex -> ops window/runbook, leah -> sampling + QA, I'll coordinate comms and KB for manual remediation.

dan_engineering: PR will include retries, webhook backoff, and progress writes to `enrichment_progress`.

alex_ops: ops runbook excerpt:
``
- start at 02:00 PT
- cap writes to 1500/hr
- monitor crm.bulk.rps and 5xx
- abort if sustained 5xx >1.5%
- on partial failure: pause, mark progress, resume
```

maria_cs: timeline: canary tomorrow 02:00 PT, full sweep Thursday 03:00 PT if canary OK. I'll notify CS leads and prep KB. :white_check_mark:
